main_text.p: danda funt atque amplificanda amici in cómendatum à nobis collata beneficia: & noua addenda petitio : vt & porro eúdem commendatum fibi habere dignetur: animi deniq; grati memorie,ftudij,officij pol­licitatio fubiungenda. Collocatio autem Collocatio ita eft inftituenda:vt in Exordio fit:aut læ titiæ declaratio, quam ex humanitate & beneuolentia amici percepimus.lib.13. e­pift.24.55.65. Aut excufatio, quod eodem fæpe apud amicum literarum exemplo v­tamur. lib.13 epist.27. Aut gratiarum actio pro præftita humanitate, hofpitalitate,li­beralitate amico cómendato.lib. 13. epist. 42.56. In parte altera beneficia exponan­tur,commendentur; amplificentur.lib.13. epist.27.43.In tertia petitio ἀξίωσις & σύσα­σις cómédatio noua inftituatur: vt quem­admodum hactenus, ita deinceps quoq; fit amicus cómendatus.lib. 13. epist.25. 27. 42.43.54. 55. 65. Pars quarta & postrema conclusfis abfoluatur:vel ἀνακαίνωσις[?], reno­uatione cómendationis & petitionis. lib. 13.epist. 43. 55.65. Vel ὑποχώρησις[?] animi grati promifsione.lib.13.epist.42.65. Vel ὑπόσιωσις[?] precifione vlterioris commendatio­nis.lib.13.epist.24. Reperiuntur autem e­Materia gratiarum actio iufmodi gratiarum actionum, quo ad res tiarum actio
Materia gratiarum actionis: note printed in the right margin, continued from the line above.

page.notes: Right-margin notes are printed as: "Collocatio" (beside "Collocatio autem"), "gratiarum" and "actionis." (beside "læ" and "&" of the line "ita eft inftituenda"), and "Materia gra-" / "tiarum actio" (beside the line "e-" to "iufmodi gratiarum actionum"). The foot entry above is a summary of that last note, not printed text; the note itself is kept in place. Greek words marked [?] are doubtful: ἀνακαίνωσις, ὑποχώρησις, ὑπόσιωσις, and ἀξίωσις/σύσα-σις are read from a small, uneven scan. The line "tiarum actio" was printed as part of the margin note and is shown there. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
